message.content:
# Briefing: Perplexity AI Meeting

**Date & Time:** November 20, 2026 at 10:00 AM IST  
**Subject:** Strategic Partnership & Product Alignment Meeting  

---

## Recent developments
* **Financial & Enterprise Growth:** Perplexity's AI answer engine has surpassed a US$750 million run-rate, driven heavily by enterprise adoption of its AI agent framework, "Computer" [2]. Major corporations like PayPal (running 74,000 queries a week) have integrated the tool into daily workflows [2].
* **Agent Expansion & Mac App:** Perplexity deployed its proactive agentic feature, **Teammates**, to the Mac desktop app for Max subscribers, allowing collaborative AI agents to handle tasks like QA, customer service, and research (expanding beyond iOS and the web) [4].
* **Open-Weights Model Release:** On November 13, 2026, Perplexity released open weights for `pplx-decider-v1.3` and `pplx-decider-flash-v1.3` on Hugging Face under the Apache 2.0 license, providing specialized text-span extraction and routing classifiers built on Qwen architectures [1].
* **Legal Challenges:** Perplexity AI faces a class action lawsuit filed in a California federal court regarding alleged undisclosed usage caps on paid subscription features [3].

---

## Talking points
* **Enterprise Scaling & Reliability:** Discuss how Perplexity’s multi-model orchestration (utilizing 19 models via "Computer") can be integrated securely into internal enterprise data pipelines.
* **Collaboration via Teammates:** Explore the utility of the new "Teammates" feature for cross-functional workflows and team automation on desktop [4].
* **Open-Weights Integration:** Review opportunities to leverage the newly released `pplx-decider-v1.3` models for local research administration, text-classification, and structured data-extraction tasks [1].

---

## Open questions
* How is Perplexity addressing enterprise data governance and security as user query volumes scale past major milestones (such as PayPal's usage metrics)?
* What is the roadmap for mitigating the impact of the recent class-action litigation regarding subscription usage caps on customer trust and retention?
* Beyond Mac and iOS, what platforms are targeted next for the rollout of proactive agentic features like "Teammates"?

---

## Sources
* [1] [CASRAI: Perplexity Releases Open-Weight Decider v1.3 and Flash Decision Models](https://casrai.org/news/perplexity-pplx-decider-v1-3-open-weights-release-2026)
* [2] [AI Magazine: Perplexity: AI Answer Engine Tops US$750m Run-Rate](https://aimagazine.com/news/perplexity-ai-answer-engine-tops-us-750m-run-rate)
* [3] [Top Class Actions: Perplexity AI sued over undisclosed usage caps on paid subscription features](https://topclassactions.com/lawsuit-settlements/lawsuit-news/perplexity-ai-sued-over-undisclosed-usage-caps-on-paid-subscription-features)
* [4] [9to5Mac: Perplexity brings AI agents feature called Teammates to the Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/11/13/perplexity-brings-ai-agents-feature-called-teammates-to-the-mac)
